name: io.github.cyanheads/nasa-power-mcp-server
description: Query NASA POWER solar, wind, building, and agroclimatology data.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Analytical workspace: duckdb (default) stages large results for SQL on supported platforms; none keeps results inline.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_DEFAULT_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB
environmentVariables.description: Per-canvas engine memory in MiB (integer >=64), not total RSS or temporary disk.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_MAX_CANVASES_PER_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: Positive tenant canvas limit; auth-none callers share one tenant.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Positive sliding canvas lifetime in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_ABSOLUTE_CAP_MS
environmentVariables.description: Absolute canvas lifetime in milliseconds, at least the sliding TTL.

environmentVariables.name: NASA_POWER_MAX_CANVASES_PER_PROCESS
environmentVariables.description: Positive process canvas cap including pending and cleanup reservations.

environmentVariables.name: NASA_POWER_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Expose explicit staged-table removal.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
